## Why

What problem this change solves and why now.

## What changed

The main behavioral changes, grouped by module when useful. A file list is
not a substitute for a behavior description.

## Verification

Commands actually run and their observed results (for example `npm test`
totals). State clearly what was not verified.

## Residual risk

Compatibility impact, uncovered platforms, and anything reviewers should
double-check.

---

Checklist:

- [ ] One logical purpose; no unrelated formatting, upgrades, or renames
- [ ] Conventional Commits title
- [ ] Documentation (both languages where applicable) and tests updated
